Institutional Heritage

Founded in Faith,
Dedicated to Excellence

For over two decades, Grace Christian High School has remained steadfast in its founding conviction: that genuine education must illuminate both intellect and conscience across Northern Uganda.

Our Mission

Intellectual & Spiritual Formation

To deliver rigorous, Christian-grounded secondary education that equips young Africans with critical intellectual capacity, moral clarity, and practical skills to transform their societies.

Our Vision

A Beacon in Eastern Africa

To stand as the benchmark model for secondary educational distinction in Uganda, known for graduates who lead with competence, integrity, and servant hearts.

School Motto

"Light and Excellence"

Drawn from Matthew 5:14, reminding each scholar that academic talent is a stewardship meant to dispel darkness and elevate humanity.

Living Our Values

Nurturing Uganda's Future in a Loving, Disciplined Environment

From morning prayers at dawn to late-evening supervised prep, our 12-acre campus off Acholi Road provides an orderly, safe, and academically rigorous sanctuary where every scholar is known by name.

Historical Context

Rebuilding Northern Uganda through Education

In the early 2000s, Northern Uganda was emerging from an era of severe regional disruption. Infrastructure was damaged and families struggled to access reputable secondary schooling without sending their children 350 kilometres away to Kampala.

Grace Christian Fellowship answered this challenge by acquiring initial classroom blocks off Acholi Road. From those initial 48 pupils, the institution has flourished into a regional academic powerhouse with modern science labs, computer hubs, and athletic grounds.

Ministry Licensing

Fully registered and licensed under the Uganda Ministry of Education and Sports (Reg No. PSS/G/042).

2003

Foundational Intake

Inaugural cohort of 48 scholars commences in Gulu City with a dedicated staff of 6 educators.

2005

First UNEB S.4 Sitting

The pioneer O-Level class achieves a 92% First Grade pass rate, establishing regional prominence.

2008

A-Level Section Launch

Accreditation granted for Advanced Level Sciences and Arts tracks, expanding campus capacity.

2014

Permanent 12-Acre Campus

Relocation to the modern multi-block facility on Acholi Road, featuring dedicated boarding hostels.

2019

STEM Centre Commissioning

Installation of specialized Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratories equipped for national practicals.

2024

Regional Pass Rate Leader

Ranked top performing non-government secondary school across Acholi and Lango sub-regions.
